Does not specify a focus distance, target setting, one-shot focus action or a guarantee that focus is achieved. No omitted-value default, direction, rate, duration, execution timing or command-specific result field is supplied by this entry.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.source_role: Direction of the adjustment; individual command prose gives positive and negative actions.
parameters.type_boundary: The sealed shared type also contains NONE. These command definitions explain POSITIVE/NEGATIVE; do not silently substitute NONE for the explicitly documented duration-zero stop.

parameters.name: rate
parameters.source_role: Percentage of the component maximum rate of change for the named setting, not a target setting value.
parameters.type_boundary: Generic Percent has an unbounded floating range and permits exceeding 100; no extra hard numeric validation range is invented for these command parameters.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.omission_semantics: Execute until a limit is reached unless superseded by a subsequent command.
parameters.source_role: Requested execution interval in floating-point seconds with source millisecond resolution; omission differs from explicit zero.
parameters.type_boundary: Do not treat omission as zero or a zero duration as an invalid positive-only interval. No behavior for negative duration is asserted.
